doc.title: Albert Warner and Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08

chapter: Eureka Brass Band and Sonny Henry
title: Eureka Band lineup when Warner joined
summary: He lists the Eureka members: Wilsons, Landry, Schatz, Verrett, Carnish, Flowers and drummers, and notes saxophones were not used.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
